basic_details.short_information: The District Surgeon, District Hospital, Hingoli (जिल्हा शल्य चिकित्सक, जिल्हा रुग्णालय, हिंगोली) has invited applications from seven types of specialist doctors: Endocrinologist, Pediatric Nephrologist, Haematologist, Pediatric Cardiologist, Orthopaedician, Pediatric Neurologist and Psychiatrist. The selected specialists will visit the DEIC department of the hospital on a per-visit contract at Rs. 5,000/- per visit under the National Health Mission. Interested specialists must hand in the application themselves at the DEIC department, District Hospital, Hingoli. The deadline is within 7 days

rows.details: District Surgeon, District Hospital, Hingoli (Arogya Seva, Government of Maharashtra)
Endocrinologist, Pediatric Nephrologist, Haematologist, Pediatric Cardiologist, Orthopaedician, Pediatric Neurologist, Psychiatrist
Rs. 5,000/- per specialist per visit (National Health Mission grant)
Contract (agreement), visits as and when needed, valid up to 31 March 2027
In person (by hand) at the DEIC department, District Hospital, Hingoli
Within 7 days from the date of publication, excluding holidays. (7 working days from 23 November 2026).

content_sections.heading: About District Hospital Hingoli DEIC
content_sections.text: District Hospital, Hingoli is a Maharashtra government hospital under Arogya Seva. It is headed by the District Surgeon and located on Akola Road, Risala Bazar, Hingoli. According to the notice, the hospital runs a DEIC department. This department treats children aged 0 to 18 years with 4D conditions and refers them for further treatment when needed. The hospital wants specialist doctors available so that these children are diagnosed and treated on time. The visits are paid from a National Health Mission grant.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice asks interested specialists to bring their application themselves to the following office: District Surgeon, District Hospital, Hingoli (DEIC Department), Akola Road, Risala Bazar, Hingoli Mode: in person, by the applicant (स्वतः आणुन दयावे). The notice does not mention post or email. When: during office hours, excluding holidays. Deadline: within 7 days from the date of publication. The notice is dated 23 November 2026, so the deadline is about 3 December 2026. Application form: the notice does not mention any prescribed form or a list of documents to attach. Office contact details printed on the letterhead: Office phone: (02456) 223086, 224117 Fax: (02456) 220253 Residence phone: (02456) 223087 Email: [email protected]

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All seven specialities are paid at the same rate under the same agreement. The notice does not give a number of posts for any speciality. Qualification: the official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. It invites "interested specialists" (इच्छुक विशेषज्ञ) in the speciality named for each post. Experience and age limit: not specified in the notice. Pay terms: the hospital receives a National Health Mission grant of Rs. 5,000/- per specialist per visit. The agreement is to pay the specialist Rs. 5,000/- for each visit. Visits: specialists attend as and when needed (जशी गरज भासेल तशी). Contract period: the agreement will remain valid up to 31 March 2027. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility requirements of each speciality.

content_sections.heading: District Hospital Hingoli Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice gives one description of the work, and it applies to all seven specialists: Attend the DEIC department of District Hospital, Hingoli as and when needed. Help with the timely diagnosis and treatment of children aged 0 to 18 years with 4D conditions who come to the department.

The application must be handed in during office hours. Holidays are not counted in the 7-day period.

faq.question: Q1. Which specialists are invited in District Hospital Hingoli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice invites seven types of specialists: Endocrinologist, Pediatric Nephrologist, Haematologist, Pediatric Cardiologist, Orthopaedician, Pediatric Neurologist and Psychiatrist. All of them will serve the DEIC department of District Hospital, Hingoli.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be handed in within 7 days from the date of publication, excluding holidays. The notice is dated 23 November 2026, so the deadline is about 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay for DEIC specialists at District Hospital Hingoli?
faq.answer: Each specialist is paid Rs. 5,000/- per visit. The money comes from a National Health Mission grant.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Bring your application in person to the District Surgeon, District Hospital, Hingoli (DEIC Department), Akola Road, Risala Bazar, Hingoli. You must hand it in during office hours.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a per-visit contract (agreement), with visits as and when needed, and it remains valid up to 31 March 2027.

faq.question: Q6. Which patients will the specialists treat?
faq.answer: The specialists will see children aged 0 to 18 years with 4D conditions who are treated at the DEIC department of District Hospital, Hingoli.

faq.question: Q7. Can diagnostic test providers also apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice also invites applications from interested providers for Karyotyping, Whole Genome Sequencing, Colour Doppler in emergency situations, DMSA Scan and DTPA Scan.
